Clean Rows estimates use the lowest total of published packages that covers your selected volume: $25 for 1,000, $199 for 10,000 and $799 for 50,000 leads. Package rounding can include extra records. Volumes of 100,000 or more require a custom quote, so no Clean Rows cost or savings figure is shown. Yearly estimates assume 12 identical monthly orders, with no annual discount or subscription. Final scope and delivery are confirmed before payment.

The comparison models use illustrative assumptions, not current provider quotes: $149 per seat per month and 1,000 monthly exports per seat for Apollo.io; $15,000 annually plus $2,500 per additional seat beyond three for ZoomInfo. The model uses your team size or estimated export-seat requirement, whichever is greater, and caps the export-seat estimate at 20. These products have different features and allowances. Compare your actual provider quotes before making a purchase.
